question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 1.
solution:
The correct answer is: **behind**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"Behind" **refers to a position that is at the back of or in the rear of something. (पीछे)

 
 
• **Example: **He stood behind the curtain, waiting for his cue.
 
 
 
• The context tells us that it all comes down to figuring out the motivations and feelings underneath the data.
 
• Hence, we can infer that the correct word to fill the blank is **'behind'**.

Therefore, the correct answer is: **behind**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **in front of **(सामने): Situated before or at the face of.

 
 
• **Example:** The car is parked in front of the building.
 
 
 
• **above **(ऊपर): At a higher level or layer.
 
 
• **Example: **The painting is hung above the fireplace.
 
 
 
• **below** (नीचे): At a lower level or layer.
 
 
• **Example:** The basement is below the ground floor.
